title: Taser Zap
blurb: The crackling electrical arc of a stun device: a nasty, snapping buzz that anyone who has ever watched an action film recognises immediately. It has become the standard effect for anything electric going wrong — shorted wiring, malfunctioning robots, science-fiction weapons and cartoon shocks alike. Editors love it because it is short, aggressive, and cuts straight through a busy mix with no processing required. Use it when a scene needs to end abruptly and a little painfully.
origin: A recording of an electrical stun device arcing.
